title: Flux 2 Pro Outpaint
description: Outpainting generation with FLUX.2 [pro] from Black Forest Labs. Optimized for maximum quality, exceptional photorealism and artistic images.

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.03 for the first megapixel of output, plus $0.015 per extra megapixel of input and output, rounded up to the nearest megapixel. For example, a 1024x1024 image will cost $0.03, and a 1920x1080 image will cost $0.045 ($0.03 for first megapixel + $0.015 for the second megapixel). Similarly, a 512x512 output will cost $0.03 ($0.03 for 0.25 megapixels, rounded to 1 megapixel).

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: The image URL to expand using outpainting.

inputs.name: expand_top
inputs.tooltip: Pixels to expand at the top of the image.

inputs.name: expand_bottom
inputs.tooltip: Pixels to expand at the bottom of the image.

inputs.name: expand_left
inputs.tooltip: Pixels to expand on the left of the image.

inputs.name: expand_right
inputs.tooltip: Pixels to expand on the right of the image.

inputs.name: auto_crop
inputs.tooltip: Whether to automatically crop the reference image when the expanded canvas does not fully contain it.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.tooltip: Quality/speed trade-off for outpainting. `high` (default) delivers the highest-fidelity results; `fast` is significantly faster and extends most scenes well but may produce lower fidelity.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: Whether to enable the safety checker. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
